top_choice_rationale: P002 (Buchwald and Hartwig, Pd-catalyzed C-N coupling) is the achievement that can be stated most precisely: a mechanism-led, ligand-controlled catalytic cycle with identified rate-limiting steps, three decades of independent use and no maturity question, with the tin-amide precedent acknowledged in the citation and a clean two-name allocation. P001 (targeted protein degradation, Crews, Deshaies, Handa) is a close second as the broadest and most conceptually novel candidacy, held back only by an unapproved heterobifunctional class and a citation that joins two strands; P003 follows because sequencing credit is lineage-dependent; P004 rests on contested in-cell evidence; no award is last because several mature, defensible proposals exist.
